aggregation.mae: Average saved spatial MAE over20 origins and100 leads per complete trajectory, then average trajectories.
aggregation.native_probability: Average CRPS and90% marginal coverage/width over all origins/leads within a qualified complete trajectory, then average qualified trajectories.
aggregation.nrmse: Trajectory RMSE divided by that trajectory permitted-training scalar SD, then average trajectories.
aggregation.reliability: Full400-origin denominators; huge finite errors retained; nonfinite failed origins yield undefined full-schedule RMSE, no imputation.
aggregation.rmse: For each trajectory with20 finite origin receipts, sqrt(mean of all20x100 saved spatial MSE values); then equal-weight mean across complete trajectories. Never average origin RMSEs to obtain trajectory RMSE.
aggregation.uncertainty: Independent NumPy trajectory bootstrap:2000 resamples,seed20261105; conditional on selected configurations and complete-case population.
aggregation.vpt_steps: Computed from the primary point forecast: the complete-path predictive mean for native probabilistic families and the deterministic rollout otherwise. Average its prespecified first threshold crossing over20 origins per complete trajectory, then average trajectories. Uncrossed horizon100 is right censored. This is not a distribution or average of per-predictive-path crossing times.

predeclared_horizon_audit.causal_interpretation: These are observed predictive outcomes. They do not identify the cause of deterioration; all selected native Track A final fits qualified under the frozen inference criterion. No general conclusion about Bayesian methods follows.
predeclared_horizon_audit.point_error_rule: For each lead and trajectory, take sqrt(mean spatial MSE over20 origins), then average trajectory root-MSE values. NRMSE uses each trajectory training SD before averaging.
predeclared_horizon_audit.point_population: Same complete trajectories as the main aggregate;20 per family except17 for POD-NVAR. All finite extreme errors retained.
predeclared_horizon_audit.probability_rule: Within each qualified complete trajectory average the saved lead CRPS and90% coverage/width over20 origins, then average qualified trajectories.

scope: All eight terminal Track A main-seed families; no cross-track or unfinished Track B ranking
